coastal.title: Belcarra Park wildfire latest: Evacuation alert and order lifted
coastal.description: Two properties on Fern Drive in Anmore were evacuated on Wednesday afternoon as a precaution, according to Metro Vancouver. There were also 35 properties on evacuation alert.

coastal.title: Metro Vancouver wildfire prompts evacuation alerts as Fraser Canyon residents go home
coastal.description: A few dozen properties near Metro Vancouver are under evacuation alert due to a nearby wildfire, while evacuees in British Columbia's Fraser Canyon may start returning home.

coastal.title: Wildfire breaks out in Belcarra Park near Port Moody, Anmore
coastal.description: The Coastal Fire Centre says the fire is burning in Belcarra Park and is an estimated 0.8 hectares in size as of Wednesday afternoon.

kamloops.title: Evacuation order expanded, new alert issued for the Quilpituk Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: This area was previously under an evacuation alert and Central Okanagan Emergency Management warned on Wednesday night that the alert may become an order.

kamloops.title: B.C. resident lost home to Bradley Creek wildfire: ‘It was all just so fast’
kamloops.description: On Saturday, the Bradley Creek wildfire, burning west of Vernon, grew rapidly when wind gusts reached more than 70 kilometres an hour.

kamloops.title: Chief says community was left ‘a war zone’ after Bradley Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: "There are some structures that, I'll be turning 67 in November and those structures were there all my life and to see them suddenly gone, it's just devastating," Dan Wilson said.

kamloops.title: Evac alert expected to be upgraded to order for Quilpituk Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: Central Okanagan Emergency Management said the evacuation orders for the 2,223 properties and evacuation alerts for 425 properties in the wildfire area will remain in place.

all.title: Fire and Climate – a special and timely collection
all.description: The 2026 wildfire season shows us that with increased wildland fire risk, more intense fire behaviour, longer seasons, and fire evolving across many landscapes, a changing climate poses significant challenges to today’s fire regimes and management strategies.
